name: Canary Flyrobin
rangeDescription: Montane forest of new guinea
description: A small bird of montane forest interior. Olive-green upperparts, yellow underparts, black bill and orange legs.

name: Ashambu Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Hill forest of southwestern india (southern kerala)
description: This is the only montane laughingthrush in its range and hence unmistakable. From forehead to nape it is pale brown with indistinct gray streaking.

name: Red-shouldered Cuckooshrike
rangeDescription: Senegambia to southern sudan, ethiopia, and eritrea, southward to northern congo, northern democratic republic of the congo, uganda, and western kenya
description: A sleek cuckooshrike in which males and females look strikingly different. Males are entirely black with a red or occasionally yellow-orange shoulder patch.

name: Friendly Bush Warbler
rangeDescription: Montane forest of northern borneo (mounts kinabalu and trus madi)
description: Though frequently derided for the reputed inaccuracy of its name, this mouse-like bird can prove quite confiding. It is, however, generally quite difficult to see in dense undergrowth; best detected by its song, a series of three piercing whistles, the last of which is long and grating.

name: Sierra Leone Prinia
rangeDescription: Montane ravines of eastern sierra leone, southern guinea, and southwestern ivory coast
description: A mostly dark gray long-tailed warbler with a striking whitish eye, buff flanks, and pinkish legs. Local and scarce in a handful of hills and mountains in Upper Guinea, where pairs and small groups skulk low down in very wet forest edge, riverine scrub, and thickets in gullies between 600 and 1600 meters of elevation.

name: Zebra Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Java
description: Extremely rare and little-known small woodpecker with a large crested head, boldly marked black-and-white wings, black chest, and big dark eyes. Male has a faint red splotch below his eye.

name: Equatorial Antpitta
rangeDescription: Central andes of colombia southward through ecuador to northern peru (north and west of the río marañón); also on the west slope of the eastern andes of colombia, in the iguaque massif in boyacá, and far southwestern santander
description: Plump, short-tailed, and long-legged bird found in Andean cloud forest in Ecuador, northern Peru, and the central Andes of Colombia; also known from one site in Colombia’s eastern Andes. Plumage is chestnut-brown with a slightly paler belly.

name: Little Black Cormorant
rangeDescription: Australasian region to malay archipelago
description: Small all-black cormorant with green eyes. Often forms large flocks both in the air and while foraging on the water.

name: Ala Shan Redstart
rangeDescription: Montane coniferous forest of northern china to northeastern tibet
description: Male is very brightly colored, even for a redstart, with extensively orange underparts, white wing patches, and a gray cap. The female is plain and easily confused with other female redstarts; watch for its noticeably paler underparts and lack of white wing patch.

name: Oaxaca Sparrow
rangeDescription: Arid highlands of southern mexico (central oaxaca)
description: Very local and endemic to interior of Oaxaca, where replaces larger and bulkier Rusty Sparrow (no known range overlap). Favors brushy woodland and edge and oak thickets with adjacent grassy areas.

name: Pacific Elaenia
rangeDescription: Western ecuador (western esmeraldas and manabí) to northwestern peru
description: A plain flycatcher restricted to dry and semi-humid forest in western Ecuador and northwestern Peru. It is best identified by the pale eyebrow and the dark, smudgy stripe that starts behind the eye and curls down behind the ear.

name: Bare-necked Umbrellabird
rangeDescription: Humid highlands of costa rica and western panama
description: Large black bird found inside forest, usually at middle levels. Reminiscent of a crow with a funky hairdo; unlike any other species in its range.

name: White-tailed Blue Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Angola to southwestern uganda, tanzania, and northern mozambique
description: Slim, slightly crested flycatcher with a long tail that is often fanned. The back is blue, the underparts pale gray, and the outer tail white.

name: Brown-breasted Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Northeastern india to southern china and northern vietnam; winters to sri lanka
description: Dull but rather cute flycatcher, with large white-framed eyes. Dark brown above and white below with a gray head, brown flanks, and two distinct dark “moustache” lines.

name: Bonaparte's Parakeet
rangeDescription: Brazil (west-central amazonia along amazon river at tefe and rio purus)
description: Long-tailed parakeet with a dark brown head, pale cheeks, and a scalloped breast. Note the lack of red on the shoulders and the blue forehead.

name: Spotted Wood-Quail
rangeDescription: Forest of southeastern mexico to far western panama
description: Elusive dark quail found in the interior of humid tropical forest in lowlands and foothills. Forages stealthily in forest interior, usually in pairs or small groups, and usually runs rather than flies when disturbed.

name: Chestnut-bellied Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Guadalcanal, malaita, and makira (solomon islands)
description: A large dark pigeon with a deep chestnut belly and undertail. Entirely dark above with a contrasting paler head.

name: Dusky Nightjar
rangeDescription: Montane forest of costa rica and western panama
description: Small dark nightjar with very limited range in the highlands of Costa Rica and Panama. Few obvious plumage features: entire body is intricately patterned with dark brown, black, and buff.

name: Gansu Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Mountains of western china (qinghai and gansu)
description: Small, confusing leaf warbler with olive-yellow upperparts, yellow brow, double wing bars, and a pale crown stripe. Extremely similar to many other small leaf warblers: Pallas’s Leaf Warbler has a brighter yellow brow stripe, and Chinese Leaf Warbler has an incrementally weaker head pattern and a small hook at the rear end of the black eye stripe.

name: White-throated Babbler
rangeDescription: Dry grassy plains of central and southern myanmar
description: Rich chestnut-brown babbler with a bright white throat and chest. Inhabits dry scrubby areas, often fairly close to human habitation.
